description: Login and token refresh work fine, but every request that carries the fresh access token to a protected endpoint is answered with 401 Unauthorized, even immediately after logging in.
data_flow: AuthService.getTokensData signs the access token with auth.secret; JwtStrategy configures passport-jwt secretOrKey from config and must use the same key
Using auth.refreshSecret makes signature verification fail for every access token
fix: Use the 'auth.secret' config key for secretOrKey.
notes: Signing side is correct; the verifying side reads the refresh secret. Refresh strategy legitimately uses auth.refreshSecret, which makes it a plausible-looking copy-paste error.
